{{Quote|Well, what do we have here? A couple of Azzameen punks. It's time we settle some hash.|Viraxo forces call out the Azzameens as they approach Viraxo 54|<ref name="XWA" />}}
This '''raid''' on the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Merchant/Legends|shipping]] [[Orbital platform/Legends|platform]] [[Viraxo 54]], owned by [[Viraxo Industries]] and in place over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denbo]], took place around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The raid was performed by the [[Azzameen family]] following an attempted [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] of the [[Azzameen cargo fields|family's cargo fields]]. The Azzameens attempted to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] a [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo container]] of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] into the facility, then prompt a visit from local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forces; the Azzameens hoped that this visit and discovery of the illicit substance would strain ties between the Viraxo and their Imperial allies, in turn damaging the Viraxo shipping company and allowing [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], an Azzameen-owned rival company to the Viraxo, to expand their own business.

However, due to unfortunate timing, the raid was unsuccessful. While the Azzameen [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] ''[[Selu]]'', masquerading as a [[Venix|Viraxo-friendly]] [[Starship/Legends|craft]] and responsible for delivering the spice, awaited docking clearance, the Azzameen ships responsible for drawing Imperial attention entered [[Denbo system/Legends|the system]] and cast suspicion over the ''Selu''{{'s}} presence. Eventually, Viraxo 54 grew wise to the the plan and disabled the vulnerable [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], forcing its pilot, [[Aeron Azzameen]], to request extraction from [[Emon Azzameen|her brother's]] [[Andrasta|ship]]. Though the Azzameens managed to inflict some damage on Viraxo assets, the Imperials were not disinclined to continue working with the Viraxo; indeed, the Azzameens' actions against the Viraxo, combined with continued support of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], served to incite the [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]] of their [[Azzameen Station/Legends|home]] and [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|business]].

==Prelude==
Following an attempted [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] against the [[Azzameen family]]'s [[Azzameen cargo fields|cargo fields]] by their company's rival [[Merchant/Legends|shipping]] company [[Viraxo Industries]]&mdash;the attempted sabotage was itself spurred by continued incidents between Viraxo and Azzameen forces; specifically, Azzameen interference in an attempted Viraxo [[Pirate/Legends|raid]] on [[Harlequin Station]]&mdash;[[Antan Azzameen]], co-owner of the Azzameen family business [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], developed a plan to strike back against the Viraxo. Under the guise of one of the Viraxo's regular suppliers, the Azzameens would deliver a [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo container]] filled with contraband [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that the Viraxo had previously used in their sabotage attempt. The Azzameens would then attract the attention of a local Imperial force, which, upon the routine inspection which followed raids, would find the container of illicit substances in the Viraxo assets. Antan expected that this would create strain between Viraxo and their allies in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; this strain would weaken Viraxo Industries, allowing the expansion of Twin Suns Transport Services.<ref name="XWA" />

==The raid==
Antan enlisted the help of his niece [[Aeron Azzameen]] and her brothers [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] and [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]]. After she installed fake [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder codes]] to disguise the family's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Selu]]'' as the regular Viraxo supplier ''[[Venix]]'', Aeron [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], container of spice in tow, to Viraxo Industries' [[Cargo Facility 1]] [[Viraxo 54]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denbo]]. She was still waiting to release the cargo when her brothers&mdash;Emon in his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class craft]] ''[[Andrasta]]'' and Ace, along with [[Droid/Legends|droid]] copilot [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], in another family YT-1300 freighter ''[[Sabra]]''&mdash;entered the system. Noting the intruders, Viraxo 54 sent its complement of [[Razor-class starfighter|''Razor''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to intercept the Azzameen craft.<ref name="XWA" />

The arrival of the Azzameen brothers was poorly timed, however; Aeron's craft, still in line to drop the container, was facing increased scrutiny as the ''Sabra'' and ''Andrasta'' continued to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] the Viraxo ships. She had identified the craft ahead of her in line as the ''[[Enkidu]]'', a Viraxo [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ship]] that was involved in several altercations with the Azzameens, including planting the spice in the Azzameen container. While her brothers were eager to engage the ''Enkidu'', Aeron's cover was growing thin; in an effort to escape suspicion, she moved to escape the [[Denbo system/Legends|system]], citing the attack underway. Viraxo 54 ordered her to cease her exit, and, when she did not comply, ordered one of the starfighters to [[Ion cannon/Legends|disable]] the fleeing YT-1300.<ref name="XWA" />

At some point, the Viraxo station informed the Empire that they required assistance; MK-09 estimated less than 5 minutes remained before their arrival and the identification of the Azzameens. Aeron, now stranded in the disabled ''Selu'', [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|radioed]] Emon for pickup, as Ace destroyed various containers and freighters scattered about the station's exterior. Once Aeron was safely aboard the ''Andrasta'',<ref name="XWA" /> Ace moved to destroy the ''Selu'' in an effort to mask the Azzameens' involvement in the raid before moving to the exit himself. He left just as an Imperial force, consisting of the [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Intruder (Marauder-class)|Intruder]]'' and its complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], entered the system to investigate.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

==Aftermath==
Though the Azzameens did deliver the spice container, managed to destroy some of the Viraxo's assets, and destroyed the link back to their family, the Viraxo suspected Azzameen involvement nonetheless and tensions increased between the two companies. Eventually, in repayment for the Azzameen sabotage at Denbo, the Viraxo contacted their Imperial allies to report the Azzameens;<ref name="XWA" /> this lead to the eventual [[Battle of Hospital|battle]] at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']], the [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]] of Azzameen assets, and Ace's enlisting in the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] where he became on of their top pilots and flew many campaigns against Imperial forces.<ref name="XWAPrima" />
